item.title: Elon Musk stoppar Tesla och SpaceX från tokeniserade aktier
item.title_en: Objections to OKXICE's tokenised shares rise to 56 companies, including Tesla and SpaceX

item.summary: Tesla, SpaceX, Amazon, Netflix, SoFi and Lam Research are among the companies that have objected to their shares being offered as tokens on OKXICE. According to CoinDesk, Decrypt and CoinMarketCap, the number of disclosed objections rose from 50 in a notice on 30 October to 56 in a notice on 2 November. By CoinDesk's tally, 49 of 62 companies have objected.
